conditions.description: Visa exempt if having a valid residence permit in one of the Schengen countries, US, or UK
Visa exempt if holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa that has been used once in a Schengen country
Visa exempt if holding a 10-year UAE residence permit with more than one year remaining validity
Visa exempt if holding a valid multiple-entry US or UK visa that has been used once in the country of issuance
Access to Andorra requires a double- or multiple-entry Schengen Visa or a Schengen Area residence permit, as Andorra has no visa regime of its own and is only accessible through France and Spain
Visitors must have a return/onward ticket and a hotel reservation confirmation. An International Certificate of Vaccination is required.
Visa on arrival for USD 100 for a maximum stay of 30 days for valid visa holders or residents of Canada, the Schengen Area member states, UK, and US
Visa required unless holding a valid B2 US Visa, which allows visa-free travel to Argentina
Diplomatic passport holders are not required to hold a visa for a maximum stay of 90 days. Passport must be valid during the entire stay.

Visa on arrival available for holders of a valid residence permit or valid visa issued by the EU and Schengen member states, USA, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, UK, Canada, Russia, Japan, or residence permit issued by UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, or Oman.

eVisa available for up to 30 days. Prior eVisa required for entry via land borders. USD 30 payable upon arrival at international airports. Passports with Armenian entry stamp are subject to extra security screening and may be subject to additional checks.
Visa on arrival for all Indian nationals who have valid Schengen, UK, US, and/or Canadian visas

eVisa / Visa on arrival for up to 14 days, including multiple-entry visas valid for 90 days, and visa on arrival for Gulf Cooperation Council residents with a validity of more than 3 months and occupation not labourer. Also, visa on arrival for holders of valid visit visas to UAE, UK, US, KSA (excluding Hajj & Umrah), Schengen, or US Green Card for 2 weeks single entry or three months multiple entry.
Visa on arrival available for diplomatic and official passport holders entering by air, road, or sea. Visa fee waived for regular or ordinary passport holders applying in India.

Visa required unless holding a visa for EU countries or Schengen area. Visa waiver applies if holding a visa for EU countries or Schengen area, including national visas which can be substituted with a Schengen visa or a national visa of an EU country. Valid for arrivals and departures via Minsk International Airport.
Visa required unless holding a multiple entry visa of the US or Canada, or a valid visa issued by a Schengen Member state, which grants visa exemption for a maximum stay of 90 days
Must have an international vaccination certificate

duration.description: Unlimited stay only in border areas; permits required for travel beyond the border

conditions.description: Permits required for travel beyond the border, subject to a BTN 1200/day Sustainable Development Fee. Apply permit through official website https://immi.gov.bt/
Indian nationals may enter Bhutan using their Voter ID card with photograph or Indian Passport to enter by air and land in border areas
Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid multiple-entry visa issued by an EU or Schengen Area member state or the US.
eVisa or Visa on arrival with fee of USD 36 applicable

Visa required for Indian citizens. National visa may be substituted with a US permanent resident card. Travelers with a US permanent resident card no longer require an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) as of 26 April 2022. Transit visa is required.

Indian nationals holding a US visa of any kind (excluding type C transit visa) with at least six months validity at the time of arrival are exempt from obtaining a Temporary Admission Visa to enter Chile

Visa required for entry. 24-hour visa-free transit available through any international airports of China, allowing domestic travel between airports. Note that due to border disputes, Chinese embassy and consulate generals issue stapled visas only for Arunachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh citizenships. Indian government does not recognize stapled visas as valid travel documents for departure, which may cause conflicts, especially for athletes.

Online visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid C or D visa issued by a Schengen Area member state or a valid visa (with 180 days left) issued by the US (except for C1 transit visas).
Visa not required if presenting a V.I.P invitation letter
Visa on arrival if a letter (visa volant) issued by the Ministry of Interior and Security is presented
Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid visa issued by the United States or with a multiple-entry visa issued by Canada or a member state of the European Union.
e-Visa must be collected at Félix Houphouët-Boigny Airport in Abidjan. e-Visa holders must arrive via Port Bouet Airport.
Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid visa issued by Canada, US, or any EU member state.
Visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 30 days for passengers with a residence permit issued by a GCC Member State, valid for at least 6 months from the arrival date
Organized tourist group of at least 10 persons with onward and return flight tickets, booked accommodation, and a signed Letter of Guarantee (LG) from an Egyptian travel agency

Air transit passengers with a confirmed onward ticket for a flight to a third country within 48 hours do not need visas; leaving the airport permitted for transit times between 6 and 48 hours; passengers with transit time less than 6 hours may leave the transit area but not the airport, except when transiting through Alexandria (HBE)
EgyptAir passengers can obtain a free 96-hour transit visa at EgyptAir transit visa office at Cairo airport
Visa on arrival obtainable only at Addis Ababa Bole International Airport. e-Visa holders must arrive via Addis Ababa Bole International Airport. e-Visa available for 30 or 90 days.
Airport transit visa is required, with some exceptions
e-Visa holders must arrive via Libreville International Airport

Visa-free for 90 days in any 180 days if holding a valid visa or residence permit issued by United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, South Korea, Ireland, Schengen area, or GCC countries
Visa required for stays longer than 24 hours. A Schengen category A visa (airport transit visa) is not required for stays of up to 24 hours within the international area.
Visa required for entry. National visa may be substituted with a valid visa issued by Canada, the US, or a Schengen Area member state.
Visa on arrival if holding a letter of invitation from sponsor or host
Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid visa issued by Canada, the US, or a Schengen Area member state.
e-VOA / Visa on Arrival for tourism purposes, fee IDR 500000, valid for 30 days
Visa required for entry. Entry permitted only if first point of entry to the Common Travel Area is in the UK. May transit without a visa.

National visa may be substituted with a UK C visa if they have first entered the United Kingdom and have been granted a stay of 180 days in the UK. They are visa exempt for a maximum stay of 90 days in Ireland or until the end of the period of stay granted in the UK, whichever is shorter.

durationIfMet.description: Maximum 180 days in the UK before entering Ireland

conditions.description: Residents in India, except those exempted from a short-term visa, need to submit documents through VFS. Residents in Australia, Brazil, Cambodia, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, Taiwan, UK, US can also apply for a single entry e-Visa for tourism purposes only and travel to Japan by air.

Application must be submitted online up to 90 days prior to travel and at least 3 days in advance. Proof of hotel reservation or invitation letter required. Yellow fever vaccination certificate required if coming from endemic countries. Can also enter on an East Africa tourist visa issued by Rwanda or Uganda.

Tourist / Transit visa for 30 days may be granted to permanent residents or valid visa holders of US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, or Schengen countries when traveling from or to these countries and satisfying the conditions specified at https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/in-en/brd/m_20446/view.do?seq=748786&page=1

Visa required for Indian citizens. US, UK, Schengen Visa or Residence Permit Holders can apply for eVisa including tourism purposes at https://kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw/. Residents of Gulf Cooperation Council in certain professions can apply for eVisa for a fee of 3 KD.

eVisa with additional requirements: applicants must receive an email after application requiring a letter of invitation from a tour company costing at least USD 50. Electronic visa holders must arrive via Manas International Airport, Osh Airport, or land crossings with China, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, or Uzbekistan. Citizens arriving through Manas International Airport can stay visa-free for up to 7 days if they have a voucher of at least USD 500 and a return ticket, or hold long-term visas from USA, UK, or Schengen zone allowing a 7-day visa-free stay with re-entry rights after 21 days.

Visa on arrival available at international airports in Luang Prabang, Pakse, and Vientiane, at 4 Thai-Lao Friendship Bridges, and at 7 border crossings. eVisa may be used at Luang Prabang, Pakse, and Vientiane airports, 3 Thai-Lao Friendship Bridges, Boten (road and railroad), and Vientiane railway station. Note that 18 of 33 border crossings are only open to regular visa holders.
An approval from the immigration department of the General Directorate of General Security (Diréction Générale de la Sûreté Générale) is required in addition to a visa.

Visa-free for Indian citizens for 30 days until 31 December 2026 for tourist purposes only. Submission of the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) within 3 days is mandatory. The online MDAC form is available at https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main?registerMain

Visa required unless holding a valid visa or permanent residence documents issued by the United States, Canada, Japan, United Kingdom, or Schengen Area member state for tourism, transit, or business purposes

Visa required for Indian citizens, but may be substituted with a valid ('C' or 'D') visa or a valid residence permit issued by the United Kingdom, Schengen Area, or European Union member state for visits up to 90 days. Exempt for Indians holding a valid residence permit or valid visas (excluding transit visas) of US or Canada. Indian citizens can apply for an e-Visa for a maximum of 90 days within a 180-day period, plus a forthcoming 90-day period (effectively, maximum 90 days in any 270-day period).

Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid visa or residence permit issued by a Schengen Area member state, UK, Ireland, the US, Japan, Canada, New Zealand, or Australia. Holder of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Business Travel card (APEC).
Visa on arrival if holding a printed confirmation from the Immigration Authority (SENAMI) Headquarters in Maputo, indicating that a visa has been approved before departure

e-Visa available for tourism (28 days) or business (70 days) purposes. e-Visa must be obtained prior to arrival and is available for arrivals via Yangon, Nay Pyi Taw, Mandalay airports, or land border crossings with Thailand (Tachileik, Myawaddy, Kawthaung) or India (Rih Khaw Dar, Tamu).
Visa on arrival can be issued for tourism at Yangon, Nay Pyi Taw, or Mandalay airports. Valid for 30 days, extendable, and valid for 1 year from 30 August 2023.

Indian nationals may enter Nepal using their Voter ID card with photograph or Indian Passport to enter by air and land. They may live and work freely under the 1950 Indo-Nepal Treaty of Peace and Friendship, implemented through Nepal Immigration laws and regulations.

Holders of an Australian Permanent Resident Visa or Resident Return Visa may be granted a New Zealand Resident Visa on arrival permitting indefinite stay, subject to meeting character requirements and obtaining an Electronic Travel Authority prior to departure
Visa required unless holding a valid visa issued by Canada, the US, or a Schengen Member State, in which case a visa on arrival is available for a maximum stay of 30 days (fee: USD 10)

Visa required. National visa may be substituted with a valid double- or multiple-entry Schengen Area visa or a British, Canadian, or U.S. visa for a maximum stay of 15 days. Proof of onward travel required. Visa must be inserted in the passport, precluding digital and card resident permits.

Visa required for entry. Schengen category A visa (airport transit visa) is not required for Indian passport holders travelling through the international transit area of an airport during a stopover or a change of flights.
14-day visa on arrival for Indian citizens holding a valid visa or residence permit from Australia, Canada, Japan, UK, US, or Schengen area, or for residents of Gulf Cooperation Council countries

Visa issuance and travel heavily restricted after 2025 Pahalgam Attack. Visa not required for pilgrims visiting Shri Kartarpur Sahib since 2019, which is closed after the attack. Sikhs (Indian passport holders) living outside India with the right to reside in a third country can apply for an e-visa under a special Pilgrim category on Nadra website.

A national visa may be substituted with a valid multiple entry visa issued by the United States (including permanent residents), United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, or an EU member state, which has been used at least once to enter those countries and with at least one year validity remaining at the time of entry into Panama

duration.description: Up to 180 days within any 365-day period

conditions.description: Visa not required for up to 180 days within any 365-day period for holders of a valid Australia, Canada, UK, US, or Schengen Area visa or permanent resident permit, valid for at least 6 months from the arrival date, for tourist or business purposes

durationIfMet.description: Up to 180 days within any 365-day period

conditions.description: Visa required for travel purposes other than tourism, including transit. A single or multiple entry eVisa for stays of up to 59 days is also available.
Visa-free for holders of a valid US, Japan, Australia, Canada, Schengen, Singapore, or UK visa or resident visa for up to 30 days (only for tourism).
Schengen category A visa (airport transit visa) is not required for Indian passport holders travelling through the international transit area of an airport during a stopover or a change of flights

Visa required for entry, except for Indian passport holders traveling through the international transit area of an airport during a stopover or a change of flights, where an airport transit visa is not required.
Must have a confirmed return ticket and a confirmed hotel reservation booked through the Discover Qatar website for the entire stay, minimum of two nights
May enter with East Africa Tourist Visa (USD 100), valid for 90 days and multiple entries in Kenya, Rwanda, and Uganda

Visa on arrival for holders of valid Schengen, UK, or US visa. Visa on arrival also available for holders of two or multiple entry short-stay valid visas issued by UK, US, or Schengen member states for stays of no more than 90 days. Additionally, 96-hour free transit visa available for passengers of Saudia or Flynas when stopover in Saudi Arabia, valid for 90 days. Visa on arrival at any international airport with a credit card payment of SR 440 (cash not accepted).

Application must be submitted online via https://evisa.welcometoserbia.gov.rs/. An invitation letter is required for private visits (proof of accommodation) or for tourist visits (proof of itinerary from a travel agency).

A valid visa or residence permit issued by any EU member state, Schengen Area member state, UK, or US for a period not exceeding 90 days in a 180-day period and within the validity of the visa or residence permit.

Application can be submitted up to 30 days before travel. Visitors must upload reservation confirmation(s) for each visitor's location of stay in Seychelles. Yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if coming from endemic countries. Payment of EUR 10 by credit or debit card. Valid for one journey only and expires once exit the country.

Visa required. May obtain online e-Service through eligible authorized travel agencies or through local sponsors (Singapore citizen or permanent residents). Indian nationals entering Singapore by any mode of transport but departing only via air or sea and holding a valid visa or long-term pass with at least 1 month validity from countries such as Australia, Canada, Germany, Japan, New Zealand, UK, US, and Switzerland may be conditionally eligible for a 96-hour Visa-Free Transit Facility (VFTF).
eVisa available at Bosaso Airport, Galcaio Airport, and Mogadishu Airport
Obtainable online. Printed visa authorization must be presented at the time of travel.

Transit visa required unless holding a valid visa or residence permit issued by the United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, Ireland, Schengen Area, Cyprus, or a residence permit issued by Andorra, Monaco, or San Marino

Visa required for entry, except for Indian passport holders traveling through the international transit area of an airport during a stopover or a change of flights, where a Schengen category A airport transit visa is not required.

A color scan of the passport must be uploaded; photographs taken with a phone are not accepted. A letter of invitation may be requested at the discretion of the consulate. If required, the applicant will be notified by email with instructions to upload the document. In cases of solo travel, a cover letter explaining that the applicant is independently organizing their itinerary without assistance from a travel agency—and is therefore unable to provide an invitation letter—may be accepted at the consulate’s discretion.
Visa-free for a stay of up to 60 days. From 1 May 2025, travelers must fill a digital arrival card (TDAC) up to three days before arrival.
Visa required for general entry. However, groups of 5 or more individuals booking through a travel agency and traveling to Tunisia for at least five days will be issued a visa on arrival.

durationIfMet.description: At least five days for visa on arrival for qualifying groups

conditions.description: Conditional single-entry eVisa issued for 30 days to holders of a valid visa or residence permit issued by one of the following: Schengen member countries, United States, United Kingdom, or Ireland

Visa required. Letter of invitation issued by a company registered in Turkmenistan and approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs can obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 10 days. They can apply to extend their stay for an additional 10 days.
eVisa valid for stays of up to 90 days. Must be obtained prior to arrival. May enter with East Africa Tourist Visa, valid in Rwanda, Uganda, and Kenya.

Visa required for Indian citizens. Indians holding a valid US, UK, or EU visit or residence visa (valid for at least 6 months) can obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 14 days. Indians with residency permits from Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, or Canada are also eligible for a visa on arrival for 14 days. Visa extension possible for an additional 14 days at AED 250. Visas can be arranged online or through certain airlines.
Visa required unless holding a biometric Irish visa endorsed with "BC BIVS" and with a valid Irish entry stamp. Other exemptions apply for Visa-free Direct Airside Transit.
5-day visa-free transit at the international airports if holding a confirmed onward ticket for a flight to a third country
Schengen visa required. Entry can only be made from Italy; thus, Italian visa rules apply.
e-Visa valid for 90 days and multiple entries. Note: In November 2023, Vietnam proposed to waive visas for citizens of India.
eVisa or Visa on arrival for up to 30 days, with 30 days for business visits and 3 months for tourists
